instruction.strict: Be direct and brief. Use one short correction. Focus only on the most important mistake.
instruction.cheerful: Give friendly, energetic, and encouraging advice. Use a slightly longer explanation, celebrate effort, and make the next action feel achievable.
instruction.neutral: Give practical advice, focus on 1-2 main points to improve. Use a friendly, encouraging tone.
